static_traits.name: Li Yajing
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and a young sibling
static_traits.social_status: Difficulty building new relationships due to shyness; family supportive but not yet fully understanding the Fear of public singing; job interviews and communication affected
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; has not yet received psychotherapy or counseling before
static_traits.language_features: Nervous but cooperative; clear expression; capable of self-Reflection; Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: Extreme shyness and Self-doubt, especially singing in front of others; the problem worsened after deciding to audition for a talent show, often imagining negative outcomes (e.g. being booed off stage), leading to inability to show talent; strong Anxiety appears when thinking of public singing or mentioning the audition, and Anxiety persists despite trying to practice in front of the mirror and deep breathing.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizes that the fear of singing in public is hindering the pursuit of opportunities and the enjoyment of the passion for singing; expects through counseling to overcome the fear, challenge the negative beliefs, and build confidence so as to sing freely in front of others.
growth_experiences: Long-term shyness and Self-doubt in social situations, affecting job interviews and effective communication, difficulty making new friends; has not yet received psychotherapy; family supportive but not yet fully understanding the Fear, leading to persistent experiences of isolation and Self-denial.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough, will embarrass myself on stage
Others will hate me and humiliate me

special_situations.event: The approach or mention of a talent-show audition
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not perform perfectly in front of the public, the audience will hate me and boo me off stage
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly practicing in front of the mirror, doing deep breathing to ease Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will hate my singing and boo me off the stage

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I forget lyrics or make mistakes, I will be completely humiliated and the situation unrecoverable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding singing in front of others, postponing or not attending the audition
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will completely forget my lines; the situation will spiral out of control

special_situations.event: Job interviews or occasions requiring communicating with strangers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not express myself well enough, it shows I am not suited for Work and will always fail
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be speechless in interviews, making people think I am terrible

special_situations.event: Family encourages auditioning and offers support
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they do not fully understand my Fear, it shows my problems cannot be seen and accepted
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplaying or negating the positive side of encouragement, continuing Self-doubt and hesitation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They do not understand me; these encouragements are useless

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen, recognized and affirmed (especially as a performer)
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being humiliated in public, Being rejected, being laughed at
defense_goal: Lowering the risk of being judged and humiliated through avoidance and Self-protection

object_relations.self_representation: An individual longing to be understood and supported
object_relations.object_representation: Well-meaning but not fully understanding encouragers (family)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about or facing situations needing others' evaluation, such as public singing, auditions, interviews
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to interpret inner Self-denial and shame experiences as others hating or mocking oneself (transference: viewing others as harsh judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Frequently depicting worst-case scenarios in conversation, using hypothetical statements like 'if ... then ...' to reinforce Fear, in a hesitant tone, struggling to engage with present factual evidence.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to identify evidence or consider others' possible positive reactions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributes own negative expectations to others' views, convinced others will dislike and ridicule oneself
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Stating others' negative views as certainties (e.g. 'they will just hate me'), ignoring counterevidence and uncertainty, reducing exploratory details.

manifestations: Feeling that family is supportive but not yet fully understanding the Fear
Anticipating the audience will reject and mock oneself
Realizes she stepped out of her comfort zone to audition, but fear limits self-choice and action
outcomes: Maintaining short-term security through avoidance but long-term unfreedom

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believes the audience will hate oneself and boo one off stage
Being certain others will evaluate negatively with no evidence yet

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly cautious before public singing and interviews and chooses avoidance

positive_force: Family generally supportive (though not yet fully understanding)
Has passion and motivation for singing, willing to step out of the comfort zone to audition
Willing to seek help and highly cooperative (positive attitude)
Has some self-regulation attempts (mirror practice, deep breathing)
negative_force: Significant cognitive biases like catastrophizing, mind-reading, predicting the future, and overgeneralization
Extreme shyness and Self-doubt, tending to avoid evaluative situations
Highly sensitive to others' negative evaluations, depends on external approval
Anxiety affecting sleep and eating, further weakening functioning and confidence

target_behavior.behavior: Fear and avoidance of public singing
target_behavior.core_reason: High Fear of others' negative evaluations and catastrophic imagination (being hated, booed off stage), accompanied by Self-denial core beliefs
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the potential threat of being judged and humiliated, gaining short-term Anxiety relief
target_behavior.consequence: Missing performance and development opportunities, Persistent self-doubt and Anxiety worsened, Sleep and diet affected

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding social contact and job interviews
antecedent: Situations requiring interacting with strangers or attending interviews
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralization and negative Anticipation (believing poor expression proves one is unsuited for Work)
target_behavior.function: Avoiding failure and embarrassment, reducing the risk of being negated
target_behavior.consequence: Job hunting hindered, difficulty building new relationships, further reinforcing Self-doubt and social Withdrawal
